conclusion_zh: 本轮可学习滤波器相对同路径固定前端的事件F1提高1.1806个百分点。结论以本轮配对控制组为准，暂不自动替换已发布boundary主方案。支持作为候选继续验证；同时需披露帧/时长指标和误报事件数量的代价。

paired_bootstrap.limitation: One trained seed; intervals condition on these fixed models and do not cover training-seed variability, speaker/source clustering or prior inspection of this test subset. Positive fraction is not a formal p value.

historical_reference.label: Previously published boundary; reference only, not the paired control

training_audit.limitation: Saved scores/checkpoints only; no new model/audio inference.

historical_control_replay.note: GPU power projection can differ from old CPU LogMel caches; not an audit requirement.

verification.final_dev_cli_scope: One clean dev recording per model; no claim of cross-device bitwise equality or all-recording prediction equivalence

limitations_zh: 只有seed666，PS eval3562此前已分析；本轮是探索性同条件比较，不是新的盲测。
录音配对bootstrap不覆盖训练种子方差、说话人/来源聚类；区间未经多重比较校正。
开发集真实时长误报率≤5%不保证测试集也≤5%；测试不重新校准。
历史主方案55.65%由CPU预计算LogMel训练得到，本轮在设备上投影功率；数值和训练轨迹可能不同，不能将两者混为同条件前端消融。
频率位移只说明前端确实学习；不能仅据位移大小断言某个频带是伪造原因，也不能将本轮条件推广到其他配置。
